text:
Rhea (Design): dropping a prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/new/onboard-smart-samples -> idea: show 1 focused starter + a secondary "More like this" carousel based on repo heuristics
Diego (PM): love the focused path. question: should the secondary be visible or collapsed behind 'More'? we don't want cognitive overload.
Rhea (Design): default collapsed, small chevron to expand. collapsed state still shows a hint: 'See more languages' so users know it's there.
Pri (Frontend): implementation: run a lightweight file-name scan in-browser for manifests. return up to 3 candidate starters. client-only; no upload.
Ivy (DevEx): UX perf note: show skeleton card immediately, replace with result. avoid layout jumps by keeping height consistent.
Sam (A11y): accessibility: when expansion happens, use `aria-expanded` on the toggle and ensure content is focusable. announce "More starter projects available" via aria-live=polite.
Diego (PM): privacy copy: "We read top-level filenames in your browser to suggest starters." short and explicit. legal wants a link to docs.
Rhea (Design): copy variants for primary CTA: 'Try starter', 'Run starter', 'Launch sample'. leaning 'Try starter' to feel low-commitment.
Pri (Frontend): add estimated runtime tags: 'Quick (<5m)' or 'Setup (~10m)'. show a tooltip: 'Estimate varies by machine.'
Ivy (DevEx): preference storage: 'Don't show suggestions' persists for session. 'Always personalize' toggles on account. events: suggestion_shown, suggestion_clicked, suggestion_skipped.
Sam (A11y): keyboard flow: when suggestions replace skeleton, focus should move to primary CTA if the user initiated scan. if it auto-updates, do NOT steal focus; just announce.
Rhea (Design): good distinction. plan: if user clicks 'Detect' -> focus the CTA after replacement. if auto-detect -> announce only.
Diego (PM): edge case: monorepos with many languages. show a language selector within the expanded list and default to "Most used".
Pri (Frontend): for monorepos, detect top-level directories and their manifests. show per-package suggestion cards. may need a 'select path' picker later.
Sam (A11y): expanded list should be navigable via arrow keys; each card needs an accessible name and role=button for the CTA. ensure contrast for small pills.
Ivy (DevEx): telemetry: capture which path the user took so we can see if suggestions reduce time-to-first-run. small metric, anonymous by default.
Rhea (Design): I'll update mocks to include collapsed state, chevron microcopy, and the privacy link. will add microcopy: 'Nothing leaves your browser unless you select a starter.'
onboard-bot: Preview for experiment/smart-starters ready -> https://preview.redwood.ai/experiment/smart-starters (staging)
Diego (PM): next steps: a11y preflight (Sam), privacy copy sign-off (legal), frontend prototype (Pri). target: beta next week.
Pri (Frontend): will spike today and push a small branch. need an a11y walkthrough for VoiceOver.
Sam (A11y): I can run VoiceOver + NVDA tests tomorrow. will flag any focus/announce issues.
Rhea (Design): thanks everyone. I'll post updated figma and call out the exact copy strings for the banner and CTA. :sparkles:
